posts.text: What's the most annoying part of researching an Indian stock? — I research Indian stocks regularly, and my process is held together by tabs and spreadsheets. These are the things that drive me up the wall: • The data is scattered: financials on one site, filings on BSE/NSE, concall transcripts somewhere else, annual reports as 300-page PDFs • Screeners give numbers, not meaning: ROCE is 18%, but is that good or bad for this sector? • It’s hard to see what changed: which quarter, which line item, which announcement actually mattered • Clean historical price data for backtesting is either paid o…
